title_original: 선거관리위원회보안관리대 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Establishment)
An Election Commission Security Management Unit (hereinafter referred to as a "Security Management Unit") shall be established within the Secretariat of the National Election Commission: Provided, That where the Secretary General of the National Election Commission deems it necessary, such a unit may be established at an election commission at any level (including the Internet Election News Deliberation Commission, the National Election Broadcasting Debate Commission and the National Election Opinion Survey Deliberation Commission, but excluding Eup, Myeon and Dong election commissions).
